summary: Four SOFT operator-experience advisories — no BLOCKERs, no engine-math defects. All four roll up into PR-DOC per program-director PD-002. Items captured here as canonical findings so dedup catches them next cycle and the autonomous loop does not re-raise.

findings.title: Operator-facing run summary lacks an at-a-glance 'what to do next' block
findings.recommended_fix: Add a 4-line 'Next steps for operator' block at the end of executiveSummary keyed on deploy_recommendation: APPROVE -> 'file as-is'; WARN -> '<numbered punch list>'; BLOCK -> 'do not file'; NO_OP -> 'no action'.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Operator feedback per technical-pmp PMP-004 PR-DOC cluster.

findings.title: Field validator should accept call signs in either case
findings.recommended_fix: Lower-case input call signs at the boundary, then normalize to upper-case for the canonical record. Currently mixed-case rejects early in form submission.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Reproducible via POST /api/exhibits with call='wblk'; current handler returns 422.

findings.title: Per-radial HAAT table column widths can clip 4-digit elevations on Letter-sized print
findings.recommended_fix: Bump elevation-column width by ~6 pts so 4-digit AMSL values render fully on Letter print. Currently clips at the rightmost digit on tall-tower exhibits.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Render any FM exhibit with antenna AMSL > 999 m and inspect the per-radial table.

findings.title: Cancel button on long-running exhibit compute returns to dashboard instead of preserving form state
findings.recommended_fix: On cancel, route back to the form with prior inputs hydrated instead of dropping the operator at the dashboard.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Reproducible by starting a >60s compute and clicking Cancel — current behavior loses entered form state.
